figures.caption: A character dashboard. 1 Name. 2 Illustration. 3 Heroic action. 4 Equipment slots. 5 Endurance bar. 6 Stat progression track. 7 Threat, printed as Taunt Level. 8 Heroic action token slot. 9 Luck token slot. 10 Estus flask token slot. 11 Ember token slot.
An equipment card. 1 Name. 2 Card type. 3 Equipment slot. 4 Set symbol. 5 Range. 6 Stat requirements. 7 Attack options. 8 Block dice. 9 Resist dice. 10 Dodge dice. 11 Upgrade slots.
An enemy data card. 1 Name. 2 Threat. 3 Base health. 4 Enemy icon. 5 Attack range. 6 Block. 7 Resist. 8 Dodge difficulty. 9 Behaviour icons. 10 Set symbol.
A movement icon. 1 Target. 2 Nodes moved towards the target. 3 Nodes moved away from the target. 4 Push icon. 5 Leap icon, used by bosses.
A boss data card. 1 Name. 2 Threat. 3 Starting health. 4 Boss type icon. 5 Behaviour deck size. 6 Block. 7 Resist. 8 Heat-up point. 9 Special ability. 10 Set symbol.
The boss tiles. The two boss tiles joined along one edge for a main-boss encounter. Each tile shows its boss spawn node in red.
Boss arcs. The lines that divide the boss's base, extended across the tile, divide the nodes among the front, left, right, and back arcs. A node on a line is in both arcs.
